name: Bollinger band-expansion momentum breakout
rationale: A high positive Bollinger z-score means price has pushed a statistically unusual distance ABOVE its band mean — the signature of a volatility-expansion breakout, not a stretched-to-fade extreme. Combined with a strong ADX (an established directional trend, so the band push is real momentum rather than chop noise) and confirming positive N-day return, this rides the expansion long. Distinct from the washout-reversion sibling (which FADES a deeply negative bb_z): this is the continuation/breakout side of the same band feature. Disconfirmer: the take-profit caps the ride, the stop fires if the breakout fails and price falls back inside the band (a failed-breakout reversal), and the signal-exit closes when bb_z collapses back toward the mean.
catalyst: volatility-expansion breakout — price breaks a statistically unusual distance above its Bollinger band mean inside an established trend
